text:
nina: heads-up: hit a nasty parity/streaming edge with jsonMode + function_call helpers in the JS SDK. When the model streams a large JSON payload (chunked), the helper sometimes validates partial fragments against a oneOf schema and accepts the wrong branch. Py path buffers differently so it doesn't fail.

nina: repro (minimal):
```js
await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-instruct-1.0',
  jsonMode: true,
  stream: true,
  function_call: { name: 'bulk_import', arguments_schema: importSchema }
})
// model streams ~100kb JSON object in many chunks
// JS helper receives first chunk "{\"items\": [ {\"id\": 1," and runs an early validate against oneOf -> picks array-branch because of partial token -> later chunks complete into { items: [{...}] } but helper already accepted wrong branch
```

sam: oh wow. so the validator is running incrementally on partial text? that explains a few weird import bugs we saw where downstream code got a different shape.

sasha: which SDK + helper versions? streaming buffer behavior changed in js@2.4.0 to reduce memory but we may have regressed.

nina: js@2.4.3, py@1.10.5, samplekit v0.26. logs show helper.validate() called after each chunk flush. python batches full message before validating. attached small trace: <link-to-gist-stream-trace>

kevin: possible fixes: 1) always buffer until a full JSON value is available before running schema validation (recommended), 2) run validation against an incremental parser that can indicate "incomplete" instead of passing, or 3) disallow oneOf with overlapping array/object branches in sample templates to reduce ambiguity.

sam: option 1 is simplest and safest for now. we can add a streamBuffering option with default=true for function_call flows and keep the low-memory behavior opt-in for heavy streaming users.

nina: agreed. short-term mitigation: samplekit scaffolds should set streamBuffering=true when jsonMode & function_call are both true. also add an integration test that streams large JSON in many chunks and asserts final validation happens only once.

sasha: i'll own the SDK change. plan: buffer until we get a well-formed top-level JSON value (using a small lightweight bracket-count+string-state parser) and only then run the helper validator. add unit tests for oneOf edge cases and for streaming partials.

kevin: also add a lint rule in samplekit to warn when a schema uses oneOf with overlapping array/object candidates for function_call helpers. that'll catch a bunch of fragile templates.

infra-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-1201 "js sdk: stream-buffering for jsonMode function_call to avoid partial-validate oneOf bug" assigned to sasha. https://tracker.internal/DEVEX-1201

sam: nice. sasha, pls also add a short docs blurb in migration notes: "If you use streaming + jsonMode + function_call, enable streamBuffering to ensure validators run on complete JSON payloads."

sasha: will do. i'll open a small PR with the buffering patch + tests, and update samplekit defaults. pinging this thread when CI green.

nina: thanks! re-running the failing import after the patch should show clean parity with Python. tagging `devex:fncall-json` and moving to triage.
